About This Game

A HIJURA special stage in the free Issue 00!

Free Issue 00 includes a special stage of the wild run & gun HIJURA SCARLET GEAR that you can only play here.
"Game Start" throws you straight into it. After clearing it, you can open HIJURA's store page too.

Start it up and you are at HU-GA Waiwai Academy

Shirote and Koyotoru greet you on the school menu: just pick a classroom.
Games, manga, music, illustrations and the creator's own voice, all of HU-GA's work in one software magazine.
Play with mouse, keyboard or gamepad. Menus and subtitles can be switched to English.

Issue 00 (free)

  • HIJURA Special Stage Edition: a special stage made only for Zolge Station Issue 00.
  • Final Re:Quest Movie Trailer - TRUE PIXEL: the trailer of the Final Re:Quest movie, not as a video but running as a program: lossless, 60fps. You can also watch it with the audio commentary (with subtitles).
  • Zolge Station Special Booklet: a booklet made for Issue 00.
  • Four Zolge Station specials: talk show episodes on starting out on Steam, the HIJURA special stage, Final Re:Quest, and the trailer's audio commentary (with subtitles).

Like it? Get Issue 01 (DLC)

New issues arrive as DLC. Open an issue from the bookshelf. Issues you do not have yet show their covers there, with a link to their store pages.
Issue 01: Final Re-Quest Original Soundtrack VOL.1 (2 discs, 57 tracks, WAV), 8bit Chronicle, THE GIRL FROM GUNMA (2014 smartphone edition), Self-Satisfaction Game, illustration gallery and more.
